rule.title: Atomic Transactions for Multi-Table Writes
rule.statement: All database write operations affecting multiple tables or cascading dependencies must be encapsulated within an atomic transaction.
rule.rationale: If a partial write fails midway (e.g. document created but chunking throws), the database is left in a corrupted, inconsistent state.

forbidden.example: await prisma.document.create(...); await externalService(); await prisma.chunk.createMany(...); // Inconsistent if chunk creation fails

preferred.example: await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => { await tx.document.create(...); await tx.chunk.createMany(...); });

source.evidence_quote: Transactions provide atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability. Operations that span multiple entities must execute within a unified transactional boundary.
